animation_description: Facing the same rear-left direction as the start frame the whole time (never turn). calm shaman spell cast in place, three phases. Frames 1-5: bring both hands together in front of the chest, palms pressed in a prayer gesture. Frames 6-8: channel, hands held at chest height with a slight rhythmic sway of the forearms, body steady. Frames 9-12: release, push both open palms forward at chest height, then settle. Hands always stay BELOW the shoulders and in front of the torso. Feet stay planted. HEADLESS body ending at a short neck stump: never draw a head, face, hair or skull. Same outfit, proportions and pixel scale. No staff, no talisman in hand, no glow, no effects, no ground shadow. Never raise fists, never flex, never lift hands above the shoulders.
